title: D1 schema and migrations for runs, signals and dispatch_log
description: Foundation contract for Phase 1 observability (D20). Add cloud/factory/migrations/0002_runs.sql defining: runs (run_id, project, epic, base_sha, requested_by, state, started_at, ended_at, cost_usd), signals (signal_id, source, external_ref, payload_digest, verdict, tick_id, received_at) and dispatch_log (run_id, tick_id, decision, reason, at). Reason codes are a closed vocabulary: budget_exhausted, lease_held_by, flake_gate, awaiting_approval, strike_out. Every dispatch refusal must be recordable with its policy reason. Include typed accessors in the worker and a test that each table round-trips through the vitest-pool-workers D1 binding. No routes and no DO logic here — this tick owns the migrations directory and the query layer only, so later ticks never race it.
